c.v: To receive more pulse codes than can be fitted in the channel's RAM, users can enable wrap mode for channel
But if RAM is accessed by DMA mode, more pulse codes than one block size can be received with no additional operation needed.
If accessed by APB bus, wrap mode has to be enabled to send more data than one block size.
In wrap mode, the receiver stores the received data to RAM space of this channel in loops.
Receiving ends, when the receiver detects no change in a signal level for a number of clock cycles more than the value set by RMT_IDLE_THRES_CH
The receiver returns to idle state and generates an RMT_CH
